description: This file defines structures and function declarations related to handling command-line options for diff format of merge commits in a version control system.

methods.name: diff_merges_config
methods.description: Configures diff merges based on the provided string value.

methods.name: diff_merges_suppress_m_parsing
methods.description: Suppresses parsing of m options in diff merges context.

methods.name: diff_merges_parse_opts
methods.description: Parses command-line options related to diff merges.

methods.name: diff_merges_suppress
methods.description: Suppresses diff merges processing in the given revision info.

methods.name: diff_merges_default_to_first_parent
methods.description: Sets the default diff merge behavior to compare with the first parent.

methods.name: diff_merges_default_to_dense_combined
methods.description: Sets the default diff merge to dense combined format.

methods.name: diff_merges_set_dense_combined_if_unset
methods.description: Sets dense combined diff merge if it hasn't been set already.

methods.name: diff_merges_setup_revs
methods.description: Initializes revision information for diff merges.
